1780년경 한성부(성 밖 포함)는 38,742호·201,070명으로 기: Around 1780, Hanseongbu (including areas outside the walls) is recorded as 38,742 households and 201,070 people. Households are not building counts. Allowing for shared dwellings and outbuildings, we assumed roughly 30,000–60,000 private buildings (0.8–1.5 buildings per registered household). This is not a survey of the historical number of buildings, and it is a reference value from a period later than the map of around 1750.
On screen, small thatched and tiled houses and shops are placed along the streets inside the city walls. Entrances and awnings face the street; roofs, wooden pillars and lattices are rough representations of hanok. The share of shops around Jongno, the ratio of thatched to tiled roofs, building dimensions and individual positions are estimates. Palaces, ritual spaces, watercourses, city walls and steep terrain were avoided. The density setting only compares how much is displayed and does not represent a population-estimate scenario.
The red road markings on the source map were extracted and overlaid on the terrain in purplish brown. They are shown independently of the old map opacity. Faint or folded areas may have gaps, and some small red symbols may be included. The line width is not a measured width.
The existing flatland placement inside the blue area is kept, and the map is stretched gradually from the foothills outward. Three mountain drawings are matched to high points in the modern elevation, and to the southwest the 萬里倉 (Mallichang) label on the source map is matched to the Mallichang site in front of Hyochangwon, stretching the map outward in a rough correction. The positions of other villages outside the city walls have not been verified yet. Turn off "Align from the foothills" to compare with the existing placement.
